item.title: Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party: "Accepts Re-Run of Democratic-Progressive Unified Candidate for Ulsan Mayor" (진보당 김종훈 “울산시장 후보 민주진보 단일화 재경선 수용”)
item.description:
Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party: "Accepts Re-Run of Democratic-Progressive Unified Candidate for Ulsan Mayor" (진보당 김종훈 “울산시장 후보 민주진보 단일화 재경선 수용”)

Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party candidate for Ulsan mayor, held an emergency press conference at his election office on the afternoon of the 27th and stated, "I accept the demand for a re-run of the primary from Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook." As a result, an agreement was reached by the 28th, the deadline for unification, averting the risk of a breakdown in candidate unification. (김종훈 진보당 울산시장 후보는 27일 오후 선거사무소에서 긴급 기자회견을 갖고 “김상욱 민주당 후보의 재경선 요구를 받아들인다”고 했다. 이에 따라 단일화 데드라인인 28일 합의에 이르면서 후보 단일화 결렬 위기는 넘기게 됐다.)

Candidate Kim said, "We will unite as a single democratic-progressive candidate to purge the insurrection forces, and we will answer the citizens' hopes for a great transformation in Ulsan," adding, "I considered the responsibility to bring together the hearts of all citizens who seek to eradicate the insurrection." (김 후보는 “민주 진보 단일후보로 마음을 모아서 내란세력을 청산해달라, 울산대전환을 이뤄야 한다는 시민들의 열망에 답하겠다”며 “내란 청산을 바라는 모든 시민의 마음을 하나로 모아내야 한다는 책임감을 생각했다”고 했다.)

Initially, candidates Kim Sang-wook and Kim Jong-hoon were scheduled to announce the results of the opinion poll primary on the 24th. However, on that day, candidate Kim Sang-wook declared a suspension of the primary, citing "evidence of interference by specific forces." The day before, candidate Kim Sang-wook proposed conducting a new opinion poll primary over the 27th and 28th with provisions to prevent strategic voting. Candidate Kim Jong-hoon rejected this, insisting on announcing the results of the previously conducted opinion poll. (당초 김상욱, 김종훈 후보는 지난 24일 여론조사 경선 결과를 발표할 예정이었다. 하지만 당일 김상욱 후보가 “특정 세력의 개입 정황이 발견됐다”며 경선 중단을 선언한 바 있다. 전날 김상욱 후보는 27~28일 양일간 역선택 방지 조항을 넣어 새롭게 여론조사 경선을 하자고 제안했다. 하지만 김종훈 후보는 이를 거부했고 기존에 진행했던 여론조사 결과를 발표하자고 했다.)

However, the Progressive Party changed its stance on this day and decided to accept candidate Kim's conditions for the primary. A Progressive Party official stated, "The issue was that candidate Kim tried to overturn the originally agreed-upon conditions, but we decided to maintain the primary itself and also accept the conditions of the Democratic Party." (하지만 진보당은 이날 입장을 바꿔 김 후보의 경선 조건을 받아들이기로 했다. 진보당 관계자는 “김 후보가 당초 합의된 조건을 엎으려고 했던 것이 문제였지만, 경선 자체는 유지하기로 하고 조건도 민주당의 조건을 수용하기로 한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee to Hold First Anniversary Press Conference on the 8th of Next Month (李대통령, 내달 8일 1주년 기자회견)
item.description:
President Lee to Hold First Anniversary Press Conference on the 8th of Next Month (李대통령, 내달 8일 1주년 기자회견)

President Lee Jae-myung will hold a press conference on the 8th to mark the first anniversary of his inauguration. (이재명 대통령이 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견을 연다.)

Lee Kyu-yeon, Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication at the presidential office, announced in a briefing on the afternoon of the 27th, “The press conference for the first anniversary of the president’s inauguration will take place on the 8th of next month at 10 a.m. in the State Guest House of the presidential office.” He added, “This conference will be an occasion to review the past year of the people’s sovereignty government and to clearly present the vision and key tasks for the second year of state affairs.” (이규연 청와대 홍보소통수석은 27일 오후 브리핑을 통해 “대통령 취임 1주년 기자회견이 다음 달 8일 오전 10시에 청와대 영빈관에서 진행된다”며 “이번 회견은 국민주권정부의 지난 1년을 되돌아보고 국정 2년 차의 비전과 주요 과제를 소상히 밝히는 자리가 될 것”이라고 했다.)

This first anniversary press conference is the fourth since the inauguration. It is expected to last approximately 100 minutes, with about 160 domestic and foreign journalists attending. Two university students, serving as campus press reporters, have also been invited to ask the president about the concerns of the younger generation. President Lee previously held press conferences on the 30th and 100th day of his term, as well as a New Year’s press conference in January. (이번 1주년 기자회견은 취임 후 네 번째다. 소요 시간은 약 100분으로 예상되며 내외신 기자 160여 명이 참석할 예정이다. 대학 언론 기자인 대학생 2명도 초청돼 청년 세대의 고민에 대해 대통령에게 질문한다. 이 대통령은 취임 후 30일, 100일을 맞아 기자회견을 했고 지난 1월 신년 기자회견을 진행했다.)

Senior Secretary Lee stated, “At this event, the president will deliver a speech marking the first anniversary of his inauguration.” He continued, “The format will follow that of previous press conferences, where journalists freely ask questions according to the president’s and moderator’s selections, without a fixed script, and the president will respond.” The conference is scheduled to be divided into three categories: people’s livelihood and economy, politics, diplomacy, and security, and society and culture. (이 수석은 “이 자리에서 대통령은 취임 1주년 기념사를 발표할 예정”이라며 “진행 방식은 앞선 기자회견처럼 기자들이 정해진 각본 없이 대통령과 사회자의 지목에 따라 자유롭게 질문하면 대통령이 답변한다”고 했다. 이번 회견은 △민생경제 △정치외교안보 △사회문화 등 세 분야로 나눠 진행될 예정이다.)

item.title: Government to Announce Investigation Results on NAMU Attack at 5 PM Today (정부, 오늘 오후 5시 나무호 피격 조사 결과 발표)
item.description:
Government to Announce Investigation Results on NAMU Attack at 5 PM Today (정부, 오늘 오후 5시 나무호 피격 조사 결과 발표)

The government will announce the investigation results on the attack targeting Korean shipping company HMM’s multipurpose carrier 'NAMU' on the afternoon of the 27th. This comes 23 days after the vessel was struck by an external attack while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th. (정부가 27일 오후 한국 해운사 HMM의 다목적 운반선 ‘나무(NAMU)호’ 피격 사건에 대한 조사 결과를 발표한다. 지난 4일 호르무즈 해협에서 정박 중 외부 공격을 당한 후 23일 만이다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, First Vice Minister Park Yoon-joo will present the government’s investigation findings regarding the NAMU at the ministry’s briefing room at 5 PM today. (외교부에 따르면 박윤주 외교부 1차관은 이날 오후 5시 외교부 청사 브리핑룸에서 나무호 관련 정부의 조사 결과를 발표할 예정이다.)

The announcement is expected to include details on the type of unidentified aircraft that attacked the NAMU. The government is known to have concluded that the weapon was likely an anti-ship missile. (이날 발표에서는 나무호를 공격한 미상 비행체의 기종 등에 대한 설명이 있을 것으로 보인다. 정부는 대함미사일일 가능성이 크다고 결론을 내린 것으로 알려졌다.)

Attention is also focused on how specifically the government will identify the perpetrator in this announcement. A senior Foreign Ministry official stated on the 14th, “It is not considered plausible based on common sense that any entity other than Iran carried out the attack.” (이번 발표에서 정부가 공격 주체를 어느 선까지 특정할 것인지에도 관심이 쏠린다. 외교부 고위 당국자는 지난 14일 “이란 이외에 다른 어떤 주체에 의한 공격 가능성은 상식적으로 크지 않다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 10th, the government announced in its initial investigation results that on the 4th at 3:30 PM local time, the NAMU was struck twice on the stern by two unidentified aircraft at approximately one-minute intervals. (앞서 정부는 지난 10일 1차 조사 결과 나무호가 4일 오후 3시 30분(현지 시각) 미상 비행체 2기에 의해 선미를 약 1분 간격으로 두 차례 타격당했다고 밝혔다.)

After on-site investigations, the government brought debris from the aircraft into the country on the 15th and has since been conducting detailed analysis at institutions such as the Agency for Defense Development (ADD). (정부는 현지 조사 이후 비행체의 잔해를 지난 15일 국내로 들여왔고, 그간 국방과학연구소(ADD) 등에서 정밀 분석 작업을 진행해 왔다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Democratic Party and Progressive Party Unify Behind Kim Kyung-soo as Gyeongnam Governor Candidate ([속보] 민주당·진보당, 경남지사 후보 김경수로 단일화)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Democratic Party and Progressive Party Unify Behind Kim Kyung-soo as Gyeongnam Governor Candidate ([속보] 민주당·진보당, 경남지사 후보 김경수로 단일화)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party unified their Gyeongnam governor candidate behind Kim Kyung-soo of the Democratic Party on the 27th. It has been reported that Progressive Party candidate Jeon Hee-young will resign from her candidacy and declare support for Kim. (더불어민주당과 진보당이 27일 경남지사 후보를 김경수 더불어민주당 후보로 단일화했다. 진보당 전희영 후보가 후보직에서 사퇴하고 김 후보 지지를 선언하는 방식이 될 것으로 알려졌다.  )

The provincial chapters of both parties reportedly reached an agreement on the unification after last-minute negotiations on the same day. This is seen as a decision to prevent a split in the opposition vote, just two days before early voting (April 29-30). (양당 경남도당은 이날 막판 협상을 거쳐 단일화에 합의한 것으로 알려졌다. 사전투표(29~30일)를 이틀 앞두고 야권 표 분산을 막기 위한 결정으로 풀이된다. )

With this unification, the Gyeongnam governor election is expected to become a two-way race between Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyung-soo and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo. <<>> (이번 단일화로 경남지사 선거는 김경수 민주당 후보와 박완수 국민의힘 후보 간 양자 대결 구도로 치러질 전망이다. )

item.title: "Bad Prosecutor" vs "College Admission Scandal": The Cho Kuk-Kim Yong-nam War of Words Continues (“나쁜 검사” vs “입시 비리” 조국·김용남 신경전 계속)
item.description:
"Bad Prosecutor" vs "College Admission Scandal": The Cho Kuk-Kim Yong-nam War of Words Continues (“나쁜 검사” vs “입시 비리” 조국·김용남 신경전 계속)

On the 27th, just one week before the June 3 local elections, Cho Kuk Innovation Party and Democratic Party candidate for Pyeongtaek-eul, Kim Yong-nam, engaged in a sharp confrontation. With the opposition party unification effectively falling apart in the five-way race for Pyeongtaek-eul, the candidates are intensifying their attacks on each other. (조국혁신당과 더불어민주당 김용남 평택을 국회의원 후보가 6·3 지방선거를 일주일 앞둔 27일 날 선 공방을 벌였다. 5자 구도로 치러지는 평택을에서 범여권 후보 단일화가 사실상 무산되는 수순으로 가면서 상대방에 대한 공격 수위를 더욱 높이는 모양새다.)

Lee Hae-min, head of the Innovation Party's election committee, held a press conference that day, raising suspicions about Kim's alleged operation of a loan shark under a borrowed name, and urged the Democratic Party to "make a swift decision." "In Pyeongtaek-eul, media scrutiny of the candidate's qualifications has continued daily, raising concerns that it could spread distrust across the entire Democratic camp," Lee said. "The reason is that in candidate Kim, we see the very 'bad prosecutor' that democratic citizens once shouted to step back from the public square." (혁신당 이해민 선대위 총괄본부장은 이날 기자간담회를 열고 김 후보의 차명 대부업체 운영 의혹을 거론하면서 민주당에 “신속히 결단해야 한다”고 했다. 이 본부장은 “평택을 지역에서는 (민주당) 후보의 자질에 대한 언론의 문제 제기가 연일 이어지면서 민주 진영 전체에 대한 불신으로 확산할 우려가 커지고 있다”며 “그 이유는 김 후보에게서 민주시민들이 광장에서 물러가라고 외쳤던 ‘나쁜 검사’ 그 자체를 보고 있기 때문”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the Innovation Party's demand for an ethical investigation by the Democratic Party, Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae had previously called for "maintaining restraint." In response, Lee said, "I'm not sure since when candidate vetting has been considered crossing the line of restraint. The Innovation Party is simply speaking from the common sense perspective of the public." (혁신당이 민주당에 윤리감찰을 요구한 데 대해 민주당 조승래 사무총장은 “금도를 지켜달라”고 했었다. 이에 대해 이 본부장은 “언제부터 후보 검증이 금도를 넘는 것으로 평가할 수 있는 건지 잘 모르겠다”며 “혁신당에선 지극히 상식적인 국민 눈높이에서 이야기하고 있다”고 했다.)

Following Lee's press conference, candidate Kim's camp issued a statement, saying, "The Innovation Party has been mobilizing all its lawmakers for days, obsessed with inflating suspicions and spreading false information about candidate Kim. They're even spewing ridiculous nonsense, demanding that our Democratic Party withdraw its candidate." (이 본부장 기자회견 뒤 김용남 후보 측은 입장문을 내고 “혁신당은 며칠째 자당의 의원들을 총동원해서 김 후보에 대한 의혹 부풀리기와 허위사실 유포에 혈안이 돼 있다. 심지어는 저희 민주당에 후보를 사퇴시키라는 둥 같잖지도 않은 망언을 내뱉고 있다”고 했다.)

"Despite all their efforts, they seem to have lost their senses, reaching extreme anxiety as no path to victory is visible," the statement continued. "We hope they take a close look at what crimes Innovation Party candidate Cho Kuk was convicted of and imprisoned for." (이어 “아무리 용을 써도 당선 가능성이 안 보이는 현실에 이성을 상실하고 초조함이 극에 달한 듯하다”며 “혁신당 조국 후보가 어떤 죄명으로 실형을 선고받고 복역했는지 살펴보길 바란다”고 했다.)

The Kim campaign added, "We urge them to deeply consider how words like 'college admission scandal, sexual assault, extramarital affair'—too distasteful to utter—are connected to their own party. Please, focus on cleaning up your own act." (이 후보 측은 “입시 비리, 성추행, 불륜 등 차마 입에 담기 께름칙한 단어들이 자당과 어떻게 연결되는지 심사숙고하길 당부한다. 제발 본인들이나 잘하라”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee visits traditional markets in Busan for two consecutive days... Opposition calls it “blatant election interference” (李, 연이틀 부산 재래시장 방문... 野 “노골적 선거개입”)
item.description:
Lee visits traditional markets in Busan for two consecutive days... Opposition calls it “blatant election interference” (李, 연이틀 부산 재래시장 방문... 野 “노골적 선거개입”)

President Lee Jae-myung visited the Busan Namhang Market for lunch on the 27th, marking his second straight day of touring traditional markets in the Busan area. The day before, he had dinner at Busan's Jagalchi Market. The People Power Party criticized this, stating, “With the local elections just a week away, this is a blatant act of election interference.” (이재명 대통령은 27일 부산 남항시장에서 점심을 먹으며 연이틀 부산 지역 재래시장을 방문했다. 전날엔 부산 자갈치시장에서 저녁 식사를 했다. 국민의힘은 “지방선거를 일주일 앞두고 노골적인 관건 선거를 한다”고 비판했다.)

According to a written briefing from senior presidential spokesperson Kang Yoo-jeong, President Lee, accompanied by First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, attended the 31st Maritime Day ceremony before moving to Busan's Namhang Market. Guided by the market merchants' association head, the presidential couple toured various parts of Namhang Market, shaking hands with citizens and taking photos. (이 대통령은 이날 김혜경 여사와 함께 제31회 바다의날 기념식에 참석한 뒤 부산 남항시장으로 이동했다. 이 대통령 부부는 상인회장의 안내를 받으며 남항시장 곳곳을 둘러보며 시민들과 악수하고 사진 촬영을 했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 서면브리핑을 통해 밝혔다.)

President Lee showed interest in a grandmother selling seafood, asking, “It seems you sell sea squirts here,” and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung purchased some, inquiring, “Can I eat it as is?” The couple then bought sugar-coated twisted doughnuts, fried foods, sweet rice drink, and mini kimbap using Onnuri gift vouchers. Together with their aides, they had lunch at a seafood restaurant inside the market, ordering raw fish and soup. After finishing their meal, they took photos with citizens before leaving the market. (이 대통령이 해산물을 파는 할머니에게 “여기서는 멍게를 파시나 봐요”라며 관심을 표했고, 김혜경 여사는 멍게를 구매하며 “그냥 먹어도 되느냐”고 물었다. 이어 시장에서 설탕을 묻힌 꽈배기와 튀김, 식혜, 꼬마김밥 등을 온누리상품권으로 구매했다. 이 대통령 부부는 참모진들과 시장 안에 있는 해산물 식당에서 회와 탕을 시켜 점심을 먹었다. 식사를 마친 뒤엔 시민들과 사진 촬영을 한 뒤 시장을 떠났다.)

The previous day, President Lee had dinner at Busan's Jagalchi Market after attending a Future Defense Strategy Committee meeting held at the Changwon Naval Base in South Gyeongsang Province. The presidential couple purchased natural sea squirts, abalone, and other seafood, including raw fish, directly from the market and had dinner with their aides at a restaurant inside. (이 대통령은 전날엔 경남 창원 해군기지에서 열린 미래국방전략위원회 회의에 참석한 뒤 부산 자갈치 시장에서 저녁을 먹었다. 이 대통령 부부는 시장에서 자연산 돌멍게와 전복 등 해산물과 회를 직접 구입해 참모진과 함께 시장 안에 있는 식당에서 저녁식사를 했다.)

As President Lee visited traditional markets in Busan for two consecutive days, the People Power Party strongly criticized it as “blatant election interference.” People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk wrote on Facebook, “It seems the election is quite urgent for Lee Jae-myung as he tours markets nationwide. Yesterday, despite the Seosomun incident, he held a ‘raw fish party’ at Jagalchi Market.” Floor leader Song Eon-seok added, “While the people are struggling, he’s laughing and chatting in the market, throwing an election-interference party. If this administration had even a shred of empathy for the people’s pain, this would be absolutely unacceptable.” (이 대통령이 연이틀 부산 지역 재래시장을 방문하자 국민의힘은 “노골적인 관건 선거”라며 강도 높게 비판했다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 페이스북에 “선거가 많이 급한지 이재명은 전국 시장 투어 중”이라며 “어제는 서소문 사고가 발생했는데도 자갈치시장에서 ‘회 파티’를 벌였다”고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 “국민이 죽어갈 때 시장에서 웃고 떠들며 선거개입 파티를 했다”며 “이 정권이 국민의 아픔에 조금이라도 공감한다면 도저히 있을 수 없는 일”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye, After Daegu and Chungcheong... Visits South Gyeongsang for People Power Party Campaign (박근혜, 대구·충청 이어... 경남 찾아 국힘 지원 유세)
item.description:
Park Geun-hye, After Daegu and Chungcheong... Visits South Gyeongsang for People Power Party Campaign (박근혜, 대구·충청 이어... 경남 찾아 국힘 지원 유세)

Former President Park Geun-hye visited South Gyeongsang Province on the 27th, following Daegu and Chungcheong, to campaign in support of People Power Party candidates. At the event, Park appealed for support for South Gyeongsang Governor candidate Park Wan-soo and Jinju Mayor candidate Han Kyung-ho, stating, "If the citizens trust and entrust you with this responsibility, I am confident you will revive the economy." (박근혜 전 대통령이 대구·충청에 이어 27일 경남을 찾아 국민의힘 후보들의 지원 유세에 나섰다. 이 자리에서 박 전 대통령은 박완수 경남지사 후보와 한경호 진주시장 후보에 대한 지지를 호소하며 “시민 여러분께서 믿고 맡겨주시면 반드시 경제를 살릴 것이라 확신한다”고 했다.)

On this day, Park visited Jinju Central Market and said, "The economy is struggling right now, and I too am very worried." She was accompanied not only by candidates Park Wan-soo and Han Kyung-ho but also by lawmakers Park Dae-chul and Kang Min-guk, who represent the Jinju area of South Gyeongsang. (박 전 대통령은 이날 진주 중앙시장을 찾아 “요즘 경제가 어려워 저도 걱정을 많이 하고 있다”면서 이같이 말했다. 이날 박 전 대통령의 지원 유세에는 박완수·한경호 후보뿐만 아니라 경남 진주를 지역구로 둔 박대출·강민국 의원 등이 동행했다.)

Arriving at Central Market around 11 a.m., Park shook hands and exchanged greetings with merchants. Hundreds of supporters flocked to the market that day to see the former president. (이날 오전 11시쯤 중앙시장에 도착한 박 전 대통령은 상인들과 악수하면서 인사를 나눴다. 이날 중앙시장에는 박 전 대통령을 보기 위해 수백 명의 지지자가 몰렸다.)

Park remarked, "When I came to Central Market last year, you warmly welcomed me, and I am grateful to see so many of you greeting me joyfully again today. I believe that candidate Park Wan-soo and candidate Han Kyung-ho, who are here with us, are both economic experts who can revive the struggling local economy." (박 전 대통령은 “제가 작년 중앙시장에 왔을 때도 따뜻하게 환대해 주셨는데, 오늘도 많은 분이 반갑게 맞아주셔서 감사하다”며 “여기 함께 자리한 박완수 후보와 한경호 후보는 모두 경제 전문가들로 어려운 지역경제를 잘 살려내실 수 있을 것이라 믿는다”고 했다.)

Candidate Park Wan-soo also emphasized in his focused campaign speech, "This local election is a vote to judge the arrogance of the runaway Democratic Party of Korea. If the Democratic Party wins, the last remaining local power will be handed over to them. I ask the citizens of Jinju to prevent a one-party dictatorship with a high voter turnout." (박완수 후보도 집중 유세 연설에서 “이번 지방선거는 폭주하는 더불어민주당의 오만을 심판하는 선거로, 만약 민주당이 승리하면 마지막 남은 지방 권력까지 넘어가게 된다”면서 “진주시민 여러분께서 높은 투표율로 일당 독재를 막아달라”고 했다.)

He added, "The southeast wind (of conservative unity), which has started blowing gently, is now sweeping through western South Gyeongsang with force. The administration of South Gyeongsang Province must be led by a proven governor—a governor who has experience in the role and can take responsibility for managing the province's affairs." (그러면서 “조금씩 불기 시작한 (보수 결집) 동남풍이 서부 경남까지 거세게 불고 있다”며 “경남도정은 검증된 도지사, 일해 본 도지사, 살림살이를 책임질 수 있는 도지사가 맡아야 한다”고 했다.)

Park had previously visited Jinju Central Market on the day before the presidential election voting day in June last year. After her schedule in Jinju, Park plans to continue her campaign by visiting the Ulsan and Busan regions in succession. (박 전 대통령은 지난해 6월 대선 투표일 하루 전날 진주 중앙시장을 방문했었다. 이날 진주 일정 이후 박 전 대통령은 울산, 부산 지역을 잇따라 찾으면서 지원 유세에 나설 예정이다.)

item.title: Ahead of Early Voting... Conservatives 'Summon Park Geun-hye' vs. Progressives 'Candidate Unification' (사전투표 앞두고… 보수는 ‘박근혜 소환’ VS 진보는 ‘후보 단일화’)
item.description:
Ahead of Early Voting... Conservatives 'Summon Park Geun-hye' vs. Progressives 'Candidate Unification' (사전투표 앞두고… 보수는 ‘박근혜 소환’ VS 진보는 ‘후보 단일화’)

Ahead of the early voting (May 29-30) for the June 3 local elections, the race for Gyeongnam Province Governor is experiencing major upheaval. The People Power Party has initiated a last-minute consolidation of conservative support through a campaign rally by former President Park Geun-hye. The Democratic Party of Korea has successfully unified with the Progressive Party candidate, turning the Gyeongnam Province Governor election into a one-on-one contest. (6·3 지방선거 사전투표(29~30일)를 앞두고 경남도지사 선거판이 크게 요동치고 있다. 국민의힘은 박근혜 전 대통령의 지원 유세를 통해 막판 보수 세 결집에 나섰다. 더불어민주당은 진보당 후보와의 단일화를 성사시키며 경남도지사 선거를 1대1 구도로 만들었다.)

On the morning of the 27th, former President Park Geun-hye visited Jinju Central Market to campaign for the People Power Party candidate. This is her first visit to Jinju in about a year, since June last year. At that time, former President Park visited Jinju Central Market the day before the official voting day of the 21st presidential election. (27일 오전 박근혜 전 대통령은 진주 중앙시장을 찾아 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세에 나섰다. 박 전 대통령이 진주를 방문한 것은 지난해 6월 이후 약 1년 만이다. 당시 박 전 대통령은 21대 대선 본투표일을 하루 앞두고 진주 중앙시장을 방문했다.)

Around 11 a.m., when former President Park appeared at Jinju Central Market, supporters, citizens, and merchants chanted the name "President Park Geun-hye." Some presented her with bouquets of flowers. Gyeongnam Province Governor candidate Park Wan-soo, Jinju Mayor candidate Han Kyung-ho, and lawmakers Park Dae-chul and Kang Min-guk, who have constituencies in Jinju, accompanied the former president. (오전 11시쯤 진주 중앙시장에 박 전 대통령이 모습을 드러내자, 지지자와 시민·상인들이 “대통령 박근혜” 이름을 연호했다. 꽃다발을 전하는 이들도 있었다. 박완수 경남도지사 후보와 한경호 진주시장 후보 등을 비롯해 진주에 지역구를 둔 박대출·강민국 의원이 박 전 대통령과 함께했다.)

Former President Park said, "I received a warm welcome at the central market last year as well, and I am grateful for the warm welcome today," adding, "The economy is difficult these days, causing much concern, but I believe candidates Park Wan-soo and Han Kyung-ho, as economic experts, can revitalize the local economy." Hundreds of supporters flocked to the central market to see former President Park, causing congestion. (박 전 대통령은 “작년에도 중앙시장에서 따뜻한 환대를 받았는데 오늘도 반갑게 맞아주셔서 감사하다”며 “요즘 경제가 어려워 걱정이 많은데 박완수 후보와 한경호 후보는 경제 전문가들로 지역 경제를 잘 살릴 수 있다고 믿는다”고 했다. 이날 중앙시장에는 박 전 대통령을 보기 위해 수백 명의 지지자가 몰리면서 혼잡을 빚었다.)

Province Governor candidate Park Wan-soo appealed, "This local election is an election to judge the out-of-control arrogance of the Democratic Party of Korea. If the Democratic Party wins this election as well, even the last remaining local power will fall into their hands. I ask the citizens of Jinju to prevent one-party dictatorship with a high voter turnout." (박완수 도지사 후보는 “이번 지방선거는 폭주하는 더불어민주당의 오만을 심판하는 선거”라며 “이번 선거마저 민주당이 승리하면 마지막 남은 지방 권력까지 넘어가게 된다. 진주 시민들이 높은 투표율로 일당 독재를 막아달라”고 호소했다.)

He continued, "The southeast wind that has started to blow gently is now blowing strongly across western Gyeongnam, and at its center is Jinju. The Gyeongnam provincial government should be led by a proven governor, a governor with experience, a governor who can take responsibility for the household economy." (이어 “조금씩 불기 시작한 동남풍이 서부 경남까지 거세게 불고 있고, 그 중심에 진주가 있다”며 “경남도정은 검증된 도지사, 일해 본 도지사, 살림살이를 책임질 수 있는 도지사가 맡아야 한다”고 했다.)

As the conservative camp rallies support by summoning former President Park, Democratic Party Gyeongnam Province Governor candidate Kim Kyung-soo and Progressive Party Gyeongnam Province Governor candidate Jeon Hee-young held a joint press conference at the Gyeongnam Provincial Office on the same day and abruptly announced a 'progressive camp unification.' (보수 진영이 박 전 대통령을 소환하며 세몰이에 나선 상황에서 더불어민주당 김경수 경남도지사 후보와 진보당 전희영 경남도지사 후보는 이날 경남도청에서 공동 기자회견을 열고 ‘진보 진영 단일화’를 전격 발표했다.)

Considering the approaching early voting period, they chose a method where candidate Jeon unconditionally withdrew and declared support for candidate Kim, without going through a complex opinion poll process. The withdrawn candidate Jeon will serve as the general election committee chair for candidate Kim Kyung-soo's election campaign committee to form a united front. This unification is the first case between the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party at the metropolitan level. It is interpreted as a strategy aimed at concentrating the progressive camp's support in the final stages of the election. (사전투표가 다가온 상황을 고려해 이들은 복잡한 여론조사 과정을 거치지 않고, 전 후보가 조건 없이 사퇴하고 김 후보 지지를 선언하는 방식을 택했다. 사퇴한 전 후보는 김경수 후보 선거대책위원회의 총괄선대위원장을 맡아 공동전선을 펴기로 했다. 이번 단일화는 광역 단위에서 민주당과 진보당 간 첫 사례다. 선거 막판 진보 진영 결집 효과를 노린 전략으로 풀이된다.)

The two candidates cited the 'end of the insurrection' and 'grand social reform' as their causes. Candidate Jeon stated, "In order to judge the People Power Party in Gyeongnam and completely end the insurrection, I have decided on an unconditional unification. Please give overwhelming support to candidate Kim to protect the future of Gyeongnam." (두 후보는 ‘내란 종식’과 ‘사회 대개혁’을 명분으로 내세웠다. 전 후보는 “경남에서 국민의힘을 심판하고 내란 완전히 끝내고자 조건 없는 단일화를 결단했다”며 “경남의 미래를 지키기 위해 김 후보에게 압도적인 지지를 보내달라”고 했다.)

Candidate Kim said, "I am grateful to candidate Jeon for making a difficult decision. This election is a choice between whether we will unite the people of Gyeongnam Province and move toward the future or return to the past. We will realize a democratic and progressive provincial administration through the direct political participation of Gyeongnam citizens and coalition politics." (김 후보는 “어려운 결단을 내려준 전 후보에게 감사하다”며 “이번 선거는 경남도민을 대통합해 미래로 나아갈 것이냐, 과거로 되돌아갈 것이냐를 선택하는 선거로, 경남도민의 직접적 정치 참여와 연합 정치를 통해 민주 진보적 도정을 실현할 것”이라고 했다.)

Along with the unification declaration, the two candidates also signed a joint policy agreement covering the strengthening of public healthcare, industrial transition and labor rights guarantees, expansion of support for agriculture and fisheries, and promotion of youth and climate policies. Civil society that participated in the unification process plans to form a 'New Gyeongnam Grand Social Innovation Committee' to support policy implementation. (두 후보는 단일화 선언과 함께 공공 의료 강화, 산업 전환 및 노동권 보장, 농어업 지원 확대, 청년·기후 정책 추진 등을 담은 공동 정책 협약도 체결했다. 단일화 과정에 참여한 시민사회는 ‘새로운 경남 사회 대혁신 위원회’를 구성해 정책 이행을 뒷받침할 계획이다.)

Both sides also exchanged critical remarks towards each other on this day. Regarding former President Park's visit to Jinju, candidate Kim stated, "I firmly reject that this local election is being held as an election to protect old power. We will fight to the end to make it an election that protects the people's livelihood, jobs, and the youth." (양측은 이날 서로를 향해 쓴소리도 냈다. 김 후보는 박 전 대통령의 진주 방문에 대해 “이번 지방선거가 낡은 권력을 지키기 위한 선거로 치러지는 것을 단호히 거부한다”며 “민생 경제와 일자리, 청년을 지키는 선거로 끝까지 싸우겠다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party criticized the unification between the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party as "an election-engineering collusion without justification." Park's chief spokesperson, Yoo Hae-nam, said, "It is an election-engineering collusion without justification or principle, united solely by the single-minded determination to stop the Park Wan-soo provincial administration. Park Wan-soo will gather greater support from the hearts of the people through his focus on livelihood and achievements." (국민의힘은 민주당·진보당 간의 단일화에 대해 “명분 없는 선거 공학적 야합”이라고 비판했다. 박 후보 측 유해남 수석대변인은 “박완수 도정을 중단시키겠다는 일념 하나로 뭉친, 명분도 원칙도 없는 선거 공학적 야합”이라며 “박완수는 민생과 성과로 도민 마음을 더 크게 모을 것”이라고 했다.)

With the withdrawal of Progressive Party candidate Jeon, the Gyeongnam Province Governor election has been restructured into a one-on-one contest between Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyung-soo and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo. (진보당 전 후보의 사퇴로 이번 경남도지사 선거는 더불어민주당 김경수 후보와 국민의힘 박완수 후보 간의 1대1 대결로 재편됐다.)

Opinion polls for the two candidates are seesawing, making it impossible to predict the winner until the election ends. (두 사람에 대한 여론조사는 엎치락뒤치락해 선거가 끝날 때까지 승부를 예측할 수 없는 상황이다.)

In an ARS survey commissioned by Gyeongnam Newspaper from polling agency Mono Research on the 24th and 25th, targeting 1,004 adults living in Gyeongnam, Democratic Party candidate Kim showed 43.1% support, and People Power Party candidate Park showed 47.8% support, indicating a close race within the margin of error. Progressive Party candidate Jeon's support was 2.7%. The response rate was 8.7%, and the sampling error is ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee website.) (경남신문이 여론조사 기관 모노리서치에 의뢰해 지난 24~25일 경남에 사는 성인 1004명을 대상으로 한 ARS 조사에서 민주당 김 후보는 43.1%, 국민의힘 박 후보는 47.8% 지지도를 보여 오차 범위 내 접전 양상인 것으로 나타났다. 진보당 전 후보의 지지도는 2.7%였다. 응답률은 8.7%, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.1%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지를 참조.))

Earlier, in a telephone interview survey commissioned by KBS Changwon Broadcasting Station conducted by Hankook Research from the 16th to the 19th, targeting 800 adults living in Gyeongnam, Democratic Party candidate Kim showed 40% support, and People Power Party candidate Park showed 35% support, indicating a close race within the margin of error. Progressive Party candidate Jeon's support was 1%. The response rate for this survey was 20.0%, and the sampling error is ±3.5 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee website.) (앞서 ㈜한국리서치가 KBS창원방송총국 의뢰로 지난 16~19일 경남에 거주하는 성인 800명을 대상으로 한 전화 면접 조사에서는 민주당 김 후보가 40%, 국민의힘 박 후보가 35% 지지도로 오차 범위 내 접전을 보이는 것으로 나타났다. 진보당 전 후보 지지도는 1%였다. 이 여론조사 응답률은 20.0%, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.5%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지를 참조.))

item.title: "Election Interference" and "Obstruction" – Political Circles in Uproar Over President Lee's Visit to Busan (“선거개입” “발목잡기” 李대통령 부산 방문에 정치권 ‘시끌’)
item.description:
"Election Interference" and "Obstruction" – Political Circles in Uproar Over President Lee's Visit to Busan (“선거개입” “발목잡기” 李대통령 부산 방문에 정치권 ‘시끌’ )

President Lee Jae-myung visited Busan, a key battleground, on the 27th and highlighted the achievements of former Presidents Park Chung-hee and Kim Young-sam. As the June 3 local elections approach within a week, interpretations are emerging that President Lee has begun providing rear-guard support for Democratic Party of Korea candidates. The conservative camp has also raised counterarguments, calling it "blatant election interference." (이재명 대통령이 27일 격전지로 꼽히는 부산을 찾아 박정희·김영삼 전 대통령의 업적을 거론했다. 이를 두고 정치권에선 6·3 지방선거가 일주일 앞으로 다가온 가운데 이 대통령이 더불어민주당 후보들에 대한 후방 지원에 나섰다는 해석이 나오고 있다. 보수진영에서는 “노골적인 선거개입”이라는 반박도 제기되고 있다.)

During the "31st Sea Day" ceremony held at the National Korea Maritime and Ocean University in Yeongdo-gu, Busan, President Lee stated, "We will realize the vision of a maritime powerhouse in the southeastern region," adding, "Fostering the 'Southern Maritime Capital Region' is a balanced growth strategy that directly links the maritime powerhouse vision to jobs and regional vitality." (이 대통령은 이날 부산 영도구 국립한국해양대에서 개최된 ‘제31회 바다의날’ 기념식에서 “해양강국의 비전을 동남권에서 실현하겠다”며 “‘남부 해양수도권’ 육성은 해양강국 비전을 일자리와 지역의 활력으로 직결시키는 균형성장 전략”이라고 말했다.)

Furthermore, President Lee said, "Just like the dedication of the dispatched miners and nurses during the industrialization era, the silent footsteps of our seafarers and fisheries workers are also great achievements that must be proudly inscribed in the history of Korea's industrialization," and "The People's Sovereignty Government will accelerate the bold leap toward the maritime powerhouse Korea that President Kim Young-sam dreamed of." This marked a reference to the accomplishments of Presidents Park Chung-hee and Kim Young-sam in Busan. President Lee also visited Busan's Jagalchi Market on the 26th and Namhang Market the following day, making two consecutive visits. <<> In response, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running for the Busan North Gap by-election, met with reporters and said, "President Lee tried to interfere in the Busan election by talking about the spirit of Kim Young-sam and Park Chung-hee here in Busan." He added, "Go ahead and interfere in the election all you want, but take responsibility for the results," and "Let's have a proper fight right here in Busan North Gap with the true conservative Han Dong-hoon." In Busan North Gap, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, a former senior presidential secretary for AI under Lee Jae-myung, is running. <<> Regarding President Lee's mention of former presidents' achievements, Candidate Han also pointed out, "President Lee lacks both the patriotism of President Park Chung-hee and the guts and spirit of President Kim Young-sam. Because he has none of that patriotism, guts, or spirit, he is engaging in system-destroying actions like withdrawal of indictment to erase his own crimes." He continued, "Here in Busan, I will use the patriotism of President Park Chung-hee and the spirit and guts of President Kim Young-sam to crush Lee Jae-myung's regime's rampage of withdrawing indictments," and "Let's meet at the June 3 election, President Lee Jae-myung." <<> The ruling and opposition parties also engaged in a war of words. People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok wrote on Facebook, "Even if the election is urgent, how can it be normal for a president to be happily having a raw fish party at Jagalchi Market after an accident that killed three citizens due to the collapse of the Seosomun overpass in Seoul?" and "When even candidates from both parties are halting their campaign schedules, should the president, as the ultimate responsible person for national safety, have been solely focused on the election?" <<> Central Election Committee Public Relations Chief Park Seong-hoon also stated in a commentary, "President Lee's blatant election interference, abandoning his duty of neutrality, has reached its peak," and "Is this outright government-backed election manipulation because public opinion in Busan has turned?" In response, Democratic Party Campaign Committee Spokesperson Kim Hyun-jung said in a written briefing, "It's a tantrum and habitual obstruction demanding that the president do nothing, since his good performance would hurt their own election prospects," and asked, "We ask the People Power Party. Are you demanding that the president's clock stop during the election period?" (또 이 대통령은 “산업화 시대 파독 광부·간호사들의 헌신처럼 우리 선원들과 해양수산 종사자들의 묵묵한 발자취 역시 대한민국 산업화 역사에 당당히 새겨져야 할 위대한 업적”이라며 “국민주권정부는 김영삼 대통령께서 꿈꾸셨던 해양강국 대한민국으로의 힘찬 도약을 앞당기겠다”고 했다. 부산에서 박정희·김영삼 대통령의 성취를 언급한 것이다. 이 대통령은 지난 26일엔 부산 자갈치시장, 이날에는 부산 남항시장을 연이틀 방문하기도 했다.)

item.description:

People Power Party candidate for Chungcheongbuk-do Governor, Kim Young-hwan, has applied pressure by raising questions about the Democratic Party of Korea candidate Shin Yong-han's dubious asset formation and tax payment record. <<> Kim's campaign spokesperson held a press conference at the Chungcheongbuk-do Provincial Government briefing room on the 27th and stated, "From the perspective of the province residents, common-sense questions arise regarding Candidate Shin's process of asset formation and tax payment structure," launching a public inquiry. <<> Kim's side claimed, based on asset declaration data from the National Election Commission, that out of Candidate Shin's total assets of approximately 3.3 billion won, about 2.9 billion won is in the form of 'private bonds.' Private bonds are claims arising from financial transactions between individuals. <<> Kim's side said, "From the residents' standpoint, it is inevitable to wonder who the money was lent to, under what pretext, whether there was any actual interest income, and whether repayments have been made properly." <<> The fact that his tax payment record over the past five years amounts to only about 12.79 million won has also come under scrutiny. <<> Kim's side asserted, "Salary workers pay millions of won in taxes every year, but it is questionable whether the tax amount paid by a candidate with assets worth billions of won is appropriate. An explanation is also needed on how living expenses and various fixed expenses have been covered, based on what income structure." <<> They added, "Asset disclosure by public office candidates is not just a simple report but a process of explaining economic activities and public responsibilities to the residents. This inquiry is part of verifying the candidate based on publicly available data from the Election Commission." <<> Earlier, Kim's side had been on the offensive, repeatedly raising suspicions surrounding Shin, including allegations of 'burner phones and illegal election campaigning' and possible media pressure. <<> In response, Shin's side rebutted, "Over the past 10 years, he has passed government and presidential office personnel verification three times, and has also undergone party-level vetting. item.title: [Breaking News] 23 Days After 'MV NAMU Attack'... Government: "High Likelihood of Iranian Missile" ([속보] ‘나무호 피격’ 23일 만에야... 정부 “이란 미사일 가능성 높다”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] 23 Days After 'MV NAMU Attack'... Government: "High Likelihood of Iranian Missile" ([속보] ‘나무호 피격’ 23일 만에야... 정부 “이란 미사일 가능성 높다”)

The South Korean government announced on the 27th that the means of attack on the 'MV NAMU,' a multipurpose carrier operated by Korean shipping company HMM, is highly likely an Iranian anti-ship missile. (한국 해운사 HMM의 다목적 운반선 ‘나무(NAMU)호’를 공격한 수단은 이란산 대함미사일 가능성이 높다고 정부가 27일 밝혔다.)

First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo stated in a briefing that afternoon, "The engine was similar to an Iranian-made turbojet engine, and markings presumed to be from an Iranian manufacturer were confirmed on the parts." (박윤주 외교부 1차관은 이날 오후 브리핑에서 “엔진의 경우 이란산 터보제트 엔진과 유사하였고 부품에서 이란의 제조사 각인으로 추정되는 것이 확인됐다”고 말했다.)

He added, "The warhead was estimated to be a dud, remaining relatively intact in shape, and resembled the warhead shape of the Iranian anti-ship missile Noor or Qader." (이어 “탄두의 경우 형태가 다소 온전한 상태인 불발탄으로 추정되었으며, 이란 대함미사일 누르 또는 카데르의 탄두 형상과 유사했다”고 밝혔다.)

Following an on-site investigation and analysis of debris—including the engine, warhead, explosives, and airframe—by the Ministry of National Defense, Vice Minister Park said, "The MV NAMU was attacked twice by unidentified aerial vehicles; the first warhead failed to explode, while the second detonated." (국방부가 현장 조사에 이어 엔진, 탄두, 화약, 기체 등의 비행체 잔해물을 분석한 결과 “나무호는 총 2번의 미상 비행체의 공격을 받았으며 첫 번째 탄두는 불폭, 두 번째 탄두는 기폭됐다”고 박 차관은 밝혔다.)

Analysis of the presumed dud warhead and high-explosive material indicated a high likelihood that it belongs to the Iranian Noor-series anti-ship missile. (불발로 추정되는 탄두와 고폭 화약 물질을 분석한 결과, 이란 대함미사일 누르 계열일 가능성이 높다는 것이다.)

In response to a question about whether Iran is behind the attack on the MV NAMU, Vice Minister Park said, "I can say that multiple pieces of evidence point toward Iran." The government plans to summon the Iranian ambassador to South Korea to convey a strong protest over the ship attack. (박 차관은 ‘나무호 공격 배후에 이란이 있다고 보는 건가’라는 질문에 “일단 여러 가지 증거가 이란 쪽을 향하고 있다고 말씀을 드릴 수 있다”고 했다. 정부는 주한 이란 대사를 초치해 선박 피격에 대한 강력한 항의의 뜻을 전달할 계획이라고 했다.)

However, regarding the specific perpetrator, he noted, "It is very difficult to definitively identify the specific entity within Iran's internal situation." This makes it challenging to pinpoint whether it was Iran's regular military, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, or Iran-backed Houthi rebels and militias. (다만 공격 주체에 대해선 “이란 내부의 상황에 대해서 구체적으로 주체를 확정하기는 매우 어렵다”고 했다. 이란 정규군이나 혁명수비대, 이란의 후견을 받는 후티 반군과 민병대 등을 특정하기는 어렵다는 것이다.)

Previously, on the 10th, the government announced in its first investigation results that the MV NAMU had been struck twice by two unidentified aerial vehicles—hitting the stern about one minute apart—and classified it as an 'external attack.' The government brought the debris into the country on the 15th and has been conducting precise analysis at institutions such as the Agency for Defense Development (ADD). (앞서 정부는 지난 10일 1차 조사 결과 나무호가 미상 비행체 2기에 의해 선미를 약 1분 간격으로 두 차례 타격당했다며 ‘외부 공격’이라고 밝혔다. 정부는 비행체 잔해를 15일 국내로 들여와 국방과학연구소(ADD) 등에서 정밀 분석 작업을 진행해 왔다.)

item.title: Early Voting for Local Elections Begins Tomorrow, Lasting Two Days (내일부터 이틀간 지방선거 사전투표)
item.description:
Early Voting for Local Elections Begins Tomorrow, Lasting Two Days (내일부터 이틀간 지방선거 사전투표)

Early voting for the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections will take place from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. over two days, May 29–30, at early voting stations nationwide. (6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재·보궐선거 사전투표가 29~30일 이틀간 오전 6시부터 오후 6시까지 전국 사전투표소에서 진행된다.)

Voters can cast their ballots at any early voting station across the country, regardless of their registered address, by presenting a valid ID such as a resident registration card, driver's license, or passport. (유권자는 주민등록증·운전면허증·여권 등 신분증을 지참하면 주소지와 관계없이 전국 어느 사전투표소에서나 투표할 수 있다.)

In general, voters in local election districts will receive a total of seven ballots. In areas where National Assembly by-elections are also held, one additional ballot will be given, making it eight ballots in total. (일반적인 지방선거 지역 유권자는 총 7장의 투표용지를 받는다. 국회의원 재·보궐선거가 함께 실시되는 지역은 1장이 추가돼 모두 8장을 받게 된다.)

Ballots are distributed in two rounds. First, voters receive and cast three ballots: for the mayor or provincial governor, superintendent of education, and head of the district or city/county. In by-election areas, voters get a fourth ballot for the National Assembly election alongside these three. (투표용지는 두 차례에 나눠 교부된다. 먼저 시·도지사, 교육감, 구·시·군의 장 선거 등 3장의 투표용지를 받아 투표한다. 재·보궐선거 지역 유권자는 국회의원 선거 투표용지 1장이 추가돼 모두 4장을 먼저 받는다.)

On the ballot for the superintendent of education election, no party names or symbols are indicated, so voters need to carefully check the candidate's name. (교육감 선거 투표용지에는 정당명과 기호가 표시되지 않기 때문에 후보자 이름을 정확히 확인할 필요가 있다.)

Afterward, voters receive and cast four additional ballots: for the local district council member (city/province), local district council member (district/city/county), proportional representative council member (city/province), and proportional representative council member (district/city/county). However, voters in Sejong and Jeju, where basic local government head and council elections are not held, receive all four ballots at once. (이후 지역구 시·도의원, 지역구 구·시·군의원, 비례대표 시·도의원, 비례대표 구·시·군의원 선거 등 4장의 투표용지를 추가로 받아 투표한다. 다만 기초단체장·기초의회 선거를 실시하지 않는 세종·제주 지역 유권자는 4장의 투표용지를 한 번에 받는다.)

Unlike presidential or National Assembly elections, overseas voting is generally not permitted for local elections. However, overseas nationals who are registered as residents and meet domestic residency requirements may vote within the country. (지방선거의 경우 대통령선거나 국회의원선거와 달리 일반적인 재외투표는 허용되지 않는다. 다만 재외국민 가운데 주민등록이 돼 있고 국내 거주 요건을 충족한 경우에는 국내에서 투표할 수 있다.)

Foreigners can also exercise their right to vote in local elections if they meet the conditions under the Public Official Election Act and the Immigration Control Act. This applies to those aged 18 or older who have held permanent residency for at least three years and are listed on the foreign resident register of the respective local government. However, they cannot participate in National Assembly by-elections. (외국인도 공직선거법과 출입국관리법상 요건을 충족하면 지방선거 투표권을 행사할 수 있다. 만 18세 이상으로 영주권 취득 후 3년이 지나고 해당 지방자치단체 외국인명부에 올라 있는 경우다. 다만 국회의원 재·보궐선거에는 참여할 수 없다.)

Meanwhile, starting May 28—six days before the election day—the publication of opinion poll results is prohibited. Results from surveys conducted before this ban period may be reported or published only if the survey date is specified. (한편 선거일 6일 전인 28일부터는 여론조사 결과 공표가 금지된다. 공표 금지 기간 이전에 실시한 조사 결과는 조사 시점을 명시하는 경우에만 보도·공표할 수 있다.)

item.title: Democratic and Progressive Parties Catch Unity Express, Ulsan Primary Resumes, Gyeongnam Candidate is Kim Kyeong-soo (단일화 막차 타는 민주·진보당, 울산 경선 재개, 경남은 김경수로)
item.description:
Democratic and Progressive Parties Catch Unity Express, Ulsan Primary Resumes, Gyeongnam Candidate is Kim Kyeong-soo (단일화 막차 타는 민주·진보당, 울산 경선 재개, 경남은 김경수로)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party agreed on candidate unity on the 27th in the Ulsan mayoral and Gyeongnam gubernatorial elections. These are regions where the Democratic Party and People Power Party candidates are in tight races. (더불어민주당과 진보당이 27일 울산시장과 경남지사 선거에서 후보 단일화에 합의했다. 민주당과 국민의힘 후보가 접전을 벌이고 있는 지역이다.)

The Democratic Party and Progressive Party agreed on the 27th to unify the Ulsan mayoral candidate through a public opinion poll on the 28th. The two parties initially planned to announce the unity result on the 24th, but the survey was suspended just before the announcement when Democratic candidate Kim Sang-wook claimed there were signs of organized interference in the poll. Subsequently, Candidate Kim requested a renewed push for unity, and Progressive candidate Kim Jong-hoon accepted the proposal on the 27th, leading to an agreement to conduct a unity poll on the 28th to determine the candidate. Meanwhile, in the conservative camp, discussions on unity between People Power Party’s Kim Doo-gyeom and independent candidate Baek Maeng-woo have stalled. <<> In the Gyeongnam gubernatorial election, conservative unity was achieved when Progressive Party candidate Jeon Hee-young endorsed Democratic candidate Kim Kyeong-soo on the same day, effectively withdrawing her candidacy. <<> In the by-election for the Pyeongtaek B constituency in Gyeonggi Province, tensions are escalating between the Democratic Party’s Kim Yong-nam and the Fatherland Innovation Party’s Cho Kuk over candidate unity. The Fatherland Innovation Party reiterated its criticism of Candidate Kim over alleged ownership of a loan company under a borrowed name and urged the Democratic Party to “make a swift decision.” This is seen as a push for unity under Candidate Cho. In response, Candidate Kim’s camp retorted, “Take a look at what charges (Candidate Cho) was sentenced and served prison time for.” However, Democratic Party representative Jeong Cheong-rae said, “We will review (unity) at tonight’s meeting.” <<> Meanwhile, People Power Party’s Yoo Eui-dong and Liberty and Innovation Party’s Hwang Kyo-ahn reportedly met recently but failed to narrow their differences over the method of unity. However, Yoo stated on KBS Radio, “There’s no reason we can’t unify,” and Hwang, in a phone call with this newspaper, said, “We are discussing through various channels,” leaving the possibility of a last-minute deal open. <<> In contrast, in the by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat, where Democratic candidate Ha Jung-woo, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon are competing, the likelihood of conservative unity appears to be diminishing. Park wrote on Facebook, “Voting for an independent candidate would repeat the tragedy of internal division and only aid the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung administration.” Han countered, “The political engineering of unity is over, and that door was closed by Candidate Park.” (민주당과 진보당은 28일 여론조사로 울산시장 후보를 단일화하기로 27일 합의했다. 양당은 애초 24일 단일화 결과를 발표하기로 했지만, 발표 직전 김상욱 민주당 후보가 여론조사에 조직적 개입 정황이 있다고 주장하면서 조사가 중단됐다. 이후 김 후보가 단일화 재추진을 요청했고, 김종훈 진보당 후보가 27일 제안을 수용하면서 양당은 28일 단일화 여론조사를 실시해 후보를 정하기로 했다. 반면 보수 진영에선 국민의힘 김두겸, 무소속 박맹우 후보 간 단일화 논의가 멈춘 상태다.)

item.title: Over 10% Point Swings Depending on Survey Methods... Confusing Polls (조사 방식에 따라 10%p 넘게 널뛰기… 헷갈리는 여론조사)
item.description:
Over 10% Point Swings Depending on Survey Methods... Confusing Polls (조사 방식에 따라 10%p 넘게 널뛰기… 헷갈리는 여론조사)

Ahead of the June 3 local elections, various polls released show significant differences in the support gap between the ruling and opposition parties depending on the survey method. The overall trend in polls indicates that the gap is narrowing in key battlegrounds such as Seoul, the Yeongnam region, and South Chungcheong. However, support rates vary markedly between ARS (automated response) surveys and telephone interview surveys conducted by interviewers calling directly. Generally, telephone interview surveys show higher support rates for the ruling party candidate, and in some regions, the difference can exceed 10% points compared to ARS surveys. <<> In the Seoul mayoral election, a wireless ARS survey conducted by Ace Research on behalf of Newsis from the 19th to the 20th with 1,002 Seoul voters showed Jeong Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea at 41.7% and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party at 41.6%, making it a very tight race. In contrast, a telephone interview survey conducted by K-Stat Research on behalf of the JoongAng Ilbo from the 17th to the 19th with 800 respondents showed Jeong at 45% and Oh at 34%, with Jeong leading outside the margin of error (±3.5% points). <<> A wireless ARS survey conducted by Realmeter and NewsPim from the 23rd to the 24th on Busan mayoral support showed Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo at 44.8% and People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon at 42.8%, a very close race with a 2% point gap. However, a telephone interview survey by Hankook Research and KBS from the 21st to the 25th showed Jeon at 46% and Park at 34%, with Jeon leading by a large margin. <<> The response rate for ARS surveys is between 2-7%, while for telephone interview surveys, it is around 10%. Experts generally believe that ARS surveys capture more "politically high-engagement individuals" compared to telephone interviews. Regarding recent poll results, a political insider commented, "After experiencing the 'Yoon Suk Yeol impeachment crisis,' opposition supporters who had distanced themselves from politics may be more willing to respond to automated ARS polls. Whether this signifies the so-called 'shy conservative' trend, the ruling party seems to be closely watching it as well." <<> Yoon Tae-gon, head of The More Political Analysis, said, "The composition of poll questions is also influencing the results. Asking whether a respondent supports President Lee Jae-myung or the Democratic Party first, before inquiring about candidate preference, inevitably affects the outcome." (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 발표되는 각종 여론조사에서 조사 방식에 따라 여야 지지율 격차가 큰 차이를 보이고 있다. 여론조사의 전체적 추이는 서울과 영남권, 충남 등 격전지에서 여야 격차가 좁혀지는 양상이다. 하지만 ARS(자동 응답) 방식이냐, 면접원이 직접 전화를 걸어 조사하는 전화 면접 방식이냐에 따라 지지율 차이가 상이하게 나타나고 있다. 대개 전화 면접 방식에서 여당 후보 지지율이 더 높게 나오는데, 일부 지역에선 ARS 조사보다 10%p 이상 높게 나오기도 한다.)

item.title: “We should pick Ha Jung-woo pushed by Jeon Jae-su” “I’ll vote for Han Dong-hoon as the opposition’s leading candidate” (“전재수가 미는 하정우 뽑아야지예” “야권 대표주자 한동훈 찍을겁니더”)
item.description:
“We should pick Ha Jung-woo pushed by Jeon Jae-su” “I’ll vote for Han Dong-hoon as the opposition’s leading candidate” (“전재수가 미는 하정우 뽑아야지예” “야권 대표주자 한동훈 찍을겁니더”)

The Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election, one of the biggest battlegrounds in the June 3 election, remained a close race even until the 27th, two days before early voting. The election initially featured a three-way contest between Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon. However, as the vote approached, it shifted into a two-horse race between Ha and Han, with Park trailing behind. (이번 6.3 선거 최대 격전지 중 한 곳인 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거는 사전투표를 이틀 앞둔 27일까지도 혼전이었다. 당초 선거는 더불어민주당 하정우, 국민의힘 박민식, 무소속 한동훈 후보의 3자 구도였지만 투표가 다가올수록 하 후보와 한 후보 간 2강 구도 속 박 후보가 그 뒤를 쫓는 양상으로 변하고 있다.)

Public sentiment among North Gap residents the newspaper met that day was sharply divided. Supporters of Ha Jung-woo said, “Jeon Jae-su, who has long been active in North Gap politics, should become Busan mayor, and Ha Jung-woo, backed by Jeon, should be elected as a National Assembly member.” This was about bolstering the Lee Jae-myung administration. Backers of Han Dong-hoon argued, “Busan has seen a major opposition leader in a long time, so we must unconditionally support him.” (본지가 이날 만난 북갑 시민들의 민심은 팽팽하게 갈렸다. 하정우 후보를 지지하는 쪽은 “북갑에서 오래 정치한 전재수는 부산시장으로, 전재수가 미는 하정우는 국회의원으로 뽑겠다”고 했다. 이재명 정부에 힘을 보태겠다는 얘기였다. 한동훈 후보 지지자들은 “부산에 오랜만에 야권의 대표 주자가 왔으니 무조건 밀어줘야 한다”고 했다.)

Notably, many expressed they would vote for Han to check the Democratic Party administration. While Democratic Busan mayoral candidate Jeon Jae-su served three terms as a National Assembly member in North Gap, this area saw People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo (50.2%) outperform President Lee Jae-myung (41.45%) in last year’s presidential election. (특히 민주당 정권의 견제를 위해서도 한 후보를 찍겠다는 의견도 상당했다. 북갑은 전재수 민주당 부산시장 후보가 3선 국회의원을 했지만 작년 대선 때는 국민의힘 김문수 후보(50.2%)가 이재명 대통령(41.45%)를 앞선 곳이기도 하다.)

Kim Jong-wook (60), a merchant at Gupo Market and a former People Power Party member, said, “I really dislike the current People Power Party leadership under Jang Dong-hyuk. This time, I’ll vote for Jeon Jae-su as Busan mayor and Ha Jung-woo as North Gap’s National Assembly member.” Lee (60), met at Deokcheon Station, said, “I’ll pick Ha Jung-woo. For Busan’s development and future generations, we need to support the government and ruling party.” (국민의힘 당원이었던 구포시장 상인 김종욱(60)씨는 “지금 국민의힘 장동혁 지도부가 너무 마음에 안 든다”며 “이번엔 부산시장엔 전재수, 북갑 국회의원엔 하정우를 찍을 것”이라고 했다. 덕천역에서 만난 이모(60)씨는 “하정우를 뽑겠다”며 “부산 발전과 부산 미래 세대를 위해선 정부·여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다”고 했다.)

In contrast, Choi Eun-seo (60), encountered on Deokcheon Station’s Youth Street, said, “I support Han Dong-hoon. Ha Jung-woo only talks about AI, and Park Min-shik has long lost public trust in the region.” Shin Ho-cheol (45) said, “I’ll vote for Jeon Jae-su as mayor, but for the assembly member, I’ll pick Han Dong-hoon. Jeon has a down-to-earth image from frequenting our market, and Han, despite his tough independent run, has something that moves people.” (반면 덕천역 젊음의 거리에서 만난 최은서(60)씨는 “한동훈을 지지한다. 하정우는 AI만 얘기하고, 박민식은 지역에서 민심을 잃은 지 오래”라고 했다. 신호철(45)씨는 “시장은 전재수를 뽑겠지만 의원은 한동훈을 뽑을 것”이라며 “전 후보는 우리 시장을 자주 찾은 서민적인 이미지이고, 한 후보는 무소속으로 쉽지 않은 상황에도 마음을 움직이는 뭔가가 있더라”고 했다.)

Some residents argued, “Shouldn’t we still vote for our hometown man, Park Min-shik?” Park Man (61) said, “Ha Jung-woo and Han Dong-hoon are suddenly outsiders from Seoul. Park Min-shik left his hometown but came back here where his elderly mother lives.” He added, “Politicians sometimes leave their hometown and return to gain support, don’t they?” (일부 주민은 “그래도 우리 고향 사람 박민식을 찍어야 하지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 박만(61)씨는 “하정우, 한동훈은 갑자기 서울에서 온 외지 사람 아니냐”며 “박민식이 고향을 떠나기도 했지만, 노모가 계신 고향에 다시 왔다”고 했다. 그러면서 “정치인들은 고향을 떠나기도 하고, 돌아와서 힘을 받기도 하지 않느냐”고 했다.)

However, many people said, “I haven’t decided who to vote for yet.” Jang In-sook (51), a fruit vendor at Gupo Market, said, “I’m torn between Ha Jung-woo and Han Dong-hoon. My mind changes several times a day.” Kim Young-hwa (64), a fried chicken shop owner, said, “For Busan mayor, I’ll vote for Democratic candidate Jeon Jae-su, who did well as a three-term lawmaker in Buk-gu. But for the National Assembly member, I’m still pondering.” (다만 “아직 누굴 뽑을지 결정하지 못했다”는 사람들도 많았다. 구포시장에서 과일 가게를 하는 장인숙(51)씨는 “하정우 후보와 한동훈 후보 중 고민하고 있다”며 “하루에도 몇 번씩 마음이 바뀐다”고 했다. 수제 통닭집 상인 김영화(64)씨는 “부산시장은 북구에서 3선 의원을 하며 잘해 온 민주당 전재수 후보를 찍을 것”이라면서도 “그런데 국회의원은 누굴 뽑을지 아직도 고민 중”이라고 했다.)

The complex sentiment in North Gap is also reflected in polls. In an Ace Research–Busan Ilbo wireless ARS survey on the 23rd–24th, Ha got 34%, Park 23.3%, and Han 38.2%. In a Gallup Korea–Segye Ilbo telephone interview survey on the 20th–21st, Ha had 35%, Park 19%, and Han 36%. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee website.) (복잡한 북갑 민심은 여론조사에서도 나타나고 있다. 에이스리서치·부산일보의 지난 23~24일 무선 ARS 조사에서 하 후보 34%, 박 후보 23.3%, 한 후보 38.2%였고, 한국갤럽·세계일보의 20~21일 전화 면접 조사에선 하 후보 35%, 박 후보 19%, 한 후보 36%였다. (중앙선거여론조사심의위 홈페이지 참조))

With the race remaining too close to call even in the final days, candidates are stepping up efforts to consolidate their support bases. On that day, Ha appeared on Kim Eo-joon’s YouTube channel, saying, “Lee Jae-myung, Jeon Jae-su, and Ha Jung-woo are the invincible fleet for national development.” Kim responded, “I’ll try to connect daily until early voting day (to promote Ha).” Park joined former President Park Geun-hye at around 5:30 p.m. when she visited Gijang Market in Busan’s Gijang County. Han continued campaigning across North Gap, holding a major rally at Gupo Station Square at 5 p.m. that evening. (이처럼 우열을 가리기 어려운 양상이 선거 막판까지 이어지자 후보들도 지지층 결집에 박차를 가하는 모습이다. 하 후보는 이날 김어준씨 유튜브에서 “이재명, 전재수, 하정우가 국가 발전 무적함대”라고 했고, 김씨는 “사전 투표일까지 (하 후보를) 매일 연결하려고 한다”고 했다. 박 후보는 이날 오후 5시 30분쯤 박근혜 전 대통령이 부산 기장군 기장시장을 방문하는 자리에 함께했다. 한 후보는 이날 오후 5시에 구포역 광장에서 집중 유세를 하는 등 북갑 일대 유세를 이어갔다.)

item.title: President Lee and Park Geun-hye Visit Key Battlegrounds… Same-Day 'Market Tour' in Busan (격전지 찾은 李대통령과 박근혜… 한날 부산서 ‘시장 투어’)
item.description:
President Lee and Park Geun-hye Visit Key Battlegrounds… Same-Day 'Market Tour' in Busan (격전지 찾은 李대통령과 박근혜… 한날 부산서 ‘시장 투어’)

With the June 3 local elections a week away, President Lee Jae-myung visited Busan on May 26-27. Over two days, he carried out official schedules in Busan and Changwon, South Gyeongsang Province, visiting traditional markets to meet with citizens and merchants. Former President Park Geun-hye visited three locations—Busan, Ulsan, and Jinju, South Gyeongsang Province—this day, appealing for support for People Power Party candidates. The Busan-Ulsan-South Gyeongsang (PK) region is the biggest battleground for the ruling and opposition parties in this election. <<> President Lee Jae-myung attended a Sea Day ceremony at Korea Maritime and Ocean University in Busan this morning, stating, "The starting point of the Republic of Korea, which launched powerfully toward the world, was right here, the sea," adding, "I will hasten a vigorous leap toward a maritime powerhouse Republic of Korea as dreamed by President Kim Young-sam." In the afternoon, President Lee chaired a preparatory status meeting for the 48th UNESCO World Heritage Committee session, set to be held in Busan this July, at BEXCO in Haeundae-gu, Busan. <<> At midday, President Lee visited Namhang Market in Busan, chatting with merchants and sharing lunch. The previous day, he chaired a Future National Defense Strategy Committee meeting in Changwon, South Gyeongsang Province, and then visited Jagalchi Market in Busan. At both markets, President Lee purchased seafood and other items using Onnuri gift certificates. <<> Former President Park Geun-hye visited Gijang Market in Gijang-gun, Busan, this afternoon. About accompanying People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon, Park said, "Candidate Park has done a lot for Busan, and I believe he will continue to do many things for the city's greater development." Regarding candidate Park Min-sik for Busan's Buk-gu Gap district, she remarked, "Candidate Park has many stories," noting, "Next month is the Month of Patriots and Veterans, and his father died in action after serving in the Vietnam War. If given the opportunity, Candidate Park will faithfully safeguard this country." <<> This morning, former President Park visited Jungang Market in Jinju, South Gyeongsang Province, and asked voters to "trust and entrust" People Power Party South Gyeongsang Province governor candidate Park Wan-soo and Jinju mayor candidate Han Kyung-ho. Later, at Shinjeong Market in Ulsan, she campaigned for People Power Party Ulsan mayor candidate Kim Doo-kyum and Ulsan's Nam-gu Gap district candidate Kim Tae-kyu. <<> Regarding the visits to the PK region by the former and current presidents, the Democratic Party and the People Power Party exchanged sharp remarks. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, "It seems the election is urgent, as Lee is on a national market tour," adding, "Yesterday (the 26th), even after the Seosomun incident, he held a 'sashimi party' at Jagalchi Market." This implies that President Lee is engaging in blatant electioneering using administrative power. Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae commented, "A president once impeached for abuse of power is now wandering around without shame." <<> Public sentiment in Busan was divided. Kim Pil-im (70), a resident of Dong-gu, said, "Life hasn't improved immediately, but President Lee Jae-myung handles diplomacy well and doesn't stir up the country," adding, "I think Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo will relocate the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries to Busan and create many jobs there." In contrast, merchant Jeon Seung-hoon (50), met at Seomyeon underground shopping center in Busan, said, "People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon, as mayor, reduced rent at Seomyeon underground shopping center," adding, "Shouldn't merchants rally behind Candidate Park with our votes?" <<> Allegations over candidate Jeon Jae-soo's alleged receipt of money from the Unification Church and evaluations of candidate Park's city administration also seemed to influence voter sentiment. Kwon Yong-hyuk (65), a resident of Saha-gu, said, "Park Hyung-joon hasn't done anything great, but he hasn't done anything terribly wrong either, so I'm thinking of voting for him," adding, "I dislike the People Power Party because of its leadership, but isn't Jeon Jae-soo a criminal?" Kim Won-ryeol (71), a resident of Haeundae-gu, said, "At first, I leaned toward Jeon Jae-soo, but now I'm unsure," adding, "The explanation about the money receipt allegations isn't clear. I think I'll keep weighing it until the final days of the election." <<> In a wireless ARS survey by Realmeter and Newspim on May 23-24, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo scored 44.8%, while People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon scored 42.8%. In a wireless ARS survey by Ace Research and Busan Ilbo on the same days, candidate Jeon scored 47.4% and candidate Park 41.5%. item.title: Government: "Iranian Missile Highly Likely in NAMU Attack" (정부 “나무호 타격, 이란 미사일 가능성 높아”)
item.description:
Government: "Iranian Missile Highly Likely in NAMU Attack" (정부 “나무호 타격, 이란 미사일 가능성 높아”)

The South Korean government announced on the 27th the results of its investigation, stating that the means used to attack the multipurpose carrier 'NAMU' of Korean shipping company HMM was highly likely an Iranian anti-ship missile. This came 23 days after the NAMU was attacked while anchored near the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th, and 12 days after its wreckage was brought to South Korea. (한국 해운사 HMM의 다목적 운반선 ‘나무(NAMU)호’를 공격한 수단은 이란산 대함 미사일일 가능성이 높다고 정부가 27일 조사 결과를 밝혔다. 나무호가 지난 4일 호르무즈 해협 인근에서 정박 중 공격당한 후 23일, 잔해를 한국에 가져온 지 12일 만이다.)

First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo said in a briefing that afternoon, "Based on technical analysis, we have concluded that it is highly likely a 'Noor' series anti-ship missile developed by Iran," adding, "For now, multiple pieces of evidence point toward Iran." Among the two missile strikes on the NAMU, the first warhead failed to detonate, and analysis of its remnants, particularly engine features and warhead shape, confirmed similarities with Iranian missiles. (박윤주 외교부 1차관은 이날 오후 브리핑에서 “기술 분석 결과, 이란에서 개발된 ‘누르’ 계열 대함 미사일일 가능성이 높은 것으로 결론을 내렸다”며 “일단 여러 증거가 이란 쪽을 향하고 있다”고 말했다. 나무호가 받은 두 차례 미사일 공격 중 첫 번째 탄두가 불발됐는데 특히 그 잔해를 분석한 결과 엔진의 특징과 탄두 형상 등에서 이란 미사일과 유사한 점들이 확인됐다는 것이다.)

Accordingly, Vice Minister Park summoned Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Koozechi to the Foreign Ministry building in Jongno-gu, Seoul, that afternoon. Before the summons, Park stated, "We will convey strong protest over the attack on our vessel and demand responsible measures." However, regarding whether the attack was intentional, he said, "We view it as very difficult to determine intent unless it is acknowledged by the other side." (이에 따라 박 차관은 이날 오후 사이드 쿠제치 주한 이란 대사를 서울 종로구 외교부 청사로 초치(招致)했다. 박 차관은 대사 초치에 앞서 “우리 선박 피격에 대한 강력한 항의의 뜻을 전달하며 책임 있는 조치를 요구할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 다만 고의적 공격 여부에 대해서는 “그쪽에서 인정하지 않는 한 고의성 자체를 파악한다는 것은 굉장히 어렵다고 보고 있다”고 했다.)

Ambassador Koozechi told reporters, "I want to express regret over the damage to the South Korean vessel." However, on whether the Iranian government would apologize, he said, "Iran denies everything related to this issue" and "Iran is absolutely not involved." (쿠제치 대사는 취재진과 만나 “한국 선박에 발생한 피해에 대해 유감의 말씀을 드리고 싶다”고 했다. 그러나 이란 정부의 사과 여부에 대해선 “이란 쪽에서는 이 문제와 관련해서는 다 부인한다”며 “절대로 (이란이) 개입되는 것이 없다”고 했다.)

The government released photos of the missile wreckage—including engine, warhead, explosives, and airframe remnants—from the attack on the NAMU that day. One dud round was relatively intact. A military source commented, "The missile shape was found virtually in original condition, so it's puzzling why the announcement came so late." (정부는 이날 나무호 공격 미사일의 엔진, 탄두, 화약, 기체 등의 잔해물 사진을 공개했으며, 불발된 1발은 형태가 비교적 온전히 보전돼 있었다. 군 소식통은 “미사일 형상이 사실상 원본 그대로 발견됐는데 한참 지나 발표하는 것은 선뜻 이해되지 않는 부분”이라고 했다.)

◇Announcement 12 Days After Bringing Missile Remains to Korea (◇미사일 실물 국내 가져오고도 12일 만에 발표)

According to the government's announcement on the 27th, the engine of the missile that struck the NAMU was similar to Iranian turbofan engines. Analysis by the Agency for Defense Development (ADD) confirmed distinctive features of Iran's 'Toloue-4' engine. Additionally, markings presumed to be from an Iranian manufacturer (TEM-T05003) were found on engine parts. The warhead shape resembled Iran's Noor anti-ship missile or its upgraded variant, Kader. (27일 정부 발표에 따르면, 나무호를 타격한 미사일 엔진은 이란산 터보제트 엔진과 유사했다. 국방과학연구소(ADD)의 엔진 분석 결과 이란제 ‘톨루에 4’ 엔진의 특징적인 부분이 확인됐다. 또 엔진 부품에서 이란의 제조사(TEM-T05003)로 추정되는 각인도 나왔다. 탄두 형상은 이란 대함 미사일 누르 또는 그 개량형인 카데르와 유사했다.)

First Vice Minister Park stated, "The circuit board remnants are estimated to have been produced about 20–30 years ago, and considering the production year, it is judged highly likely to be an older Noor missile." The Kader missile was unveiled in the 2010s, but based on analysis of the circuit board and cables, it was determined to be the older Noor. The sky-blue paint on the airframe remnants also matched Noor-series coatings and colors. (박윤주 외교부 1차관은 “전자기판 잔해물은 약 20~30년 전 생산된 것으로 추정되며, 생산 연도 고려 시 구형인 누르 미사일일 가능성이 높은 것으로 판단된다”고 했다. 카데르는 2010년대 공개된 미사일인데 기판과 케이블 등을 분석해 구형인 누르 미사일로 판단했다는 설명이다. 하늘색으로 도색된 기체 잔해물도 누르 계열 도장 및 색상과 같았다.)

Immediately after the attack on the NAMU on the 4th, the presidential office and government defined it as an 'explosion and fire.' HMM initially reported to the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, "Fire on the left side of the engine room due to external impact," and the ministry's first internal report shared with the government was 'suspected attack,' but the government maintained a cautious stance. In contrast, U.S. President Donald Trump identified Iran as the attacker right after the incident, and Iran's state-run Press TV said on the 6th, "It targeted a South Korean vessel that violated maritime rules." (청와대와 정부는 지난 4일 나무호 피격 직후 이를 ‘폭발·화재’라고 규정했다. HMM이 피격 초기 해양수산부에 “외부 충격에 의한 기관실 좌측 화재 발생”이라고 전했고, 해수부가 정부 내에 공유한 최초 보고도 “피격 추정”이었지만 ‘신중론’을 유지한 것이다. 반면 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 피격 직후 나무호 공격 주체를 이란으로 특정했고, 이란 국영 프레스TV도 6일 “해상 규정을 위반한 한국 선박을 표적으로 삼았다”고 했었다.)

However, in its first investigation results on the 10th, the government confirmed the NAMU was 'externally struck by an unidentified flying object' but stated it was 'not identifying' the attacker. A week after the attack, on the 11th, the presidential office condemned the attack without naming a specific target, saying, "Attacks on civilian vessels cannot be justified or tolerated." (하지만 정부는 지난 10일 1차 조사 결과 발표에서 나무호가 ‘미상(未詳)의 비행체에 의한 외부 타격’이라는 사실을 확인하면서도 공격 주체에 대해서는 “특정하고 있지 않다”고 했다. 청와대는 피격 후 일주일이 지난 11일 규탄 대상을 특정하지 않고 “민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화되거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로서 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 했다.)

Subsequently, the government brought the flying object's remnants into the country on the 15th and conducted detailed analyses at the ADD and other agencies. A Defense Ministry technical analysis team was also dispatched to Dubai, UAE, where the NAMU was towed, to conduct on-site inspections of the hull's breach. (이후 정부는 비행체 잔해를 15일 국내로 들여와 국방과학연구소(ADD) 등에서 정밀 분석 작업을 진행해 왔다. 나무호가 예인된 아랍에미리트(UAE) 두바이에도 국방부 기술분석팀을 파견해 선체 파공 등에 대한 현장 감식도 벌였다.)

Regarding the delay in announcing 'Iran's attack,' a government official said, "There are still 25 ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz, and we need to consider national interests." On the 20th, HMM's very large crude carrier 'Universal Winner' became the first of 26 Korea-related ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz since the Iran-U.S. conflict erupted in late February to transit the strait. (‘이란에 의한 공격’이란 발표가 늦어진 데 대해 정부 관계자는 “아직 호르무즈에 갇힌 우리 배가 25척이나 된다”며 “국익 관점에서 생각할 필요가 있다”고 했다. 지난 20일 HMM의 초대형 유조선 ‘유니버설 위너호’는 지난 2월 말 미국·이란 전쟁 발발 이후 호르무즈 해협 내에 갇힌 한국 관련 선박 26척 중 처음으로 호르무즈 해협을 통과했다.)

The government's investigation also failed to identify the missile's launch point. At the time of the attack on the 4th, the NAMU was anchored near the UAE coast inside the Strait of Hormuz, and the missile struck the stern, which faced Iran. Considering the NAMU was 90 to 100 km from the Iranian mainland, the Defense Ministry estimated the missile flew for about 6 to 7 minutes. The government viewed the attack as having clear intent to cause damage, given that the missile flew to its initially targeted altitude without additional maneuvers in the terminal phase and that two missiles were fired. (이번 정부 조사에서도 미사일의 발사 원점은 파악되지 않았다. 나무호는 지난 4일 피격 당시 호르무즈 해협 안쪽 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 닻을 내리고 있었고, 미사일은 이란 쪽을 향한 배의 선미에 꽂혔다. 국방부는 나무호가 피격 당시 이란 본토와 90∼100㎞ 떨어져 있었다는 점을 고려하면 미사일이 6∼7분가량 날아왔을 것으로 추정했다. 정부는 미사일이 종말 단계에서 별도 기동 없이 처음 목표한 지정 고도로 비행했고, 두 발이 발사됐다는 점을 고려할 때 공격을 통해 피해를 주겠다는 명백한 의도가 있는 것으로 봤다.)

However, Vice Minister Park noted regarding the attacker, "It is very difficult to definitively identify the specific entity within Iran," referring to uncertainty over whether it was Iran's regular military, the Revolutionary Guard, or Houthi rebels and militias backed by Iran. In response, Navy Brigadier General Ryu Yoonsang, Deputy Director for International Affairs at the Defense Ministry, who attended the announcement, said that while pro-Iranian forces and Syria have also been exported these missiles, "We judge that the Strait of Hormuz is fundamentally controlled by Iran's Revolutionary Guard and Navy." (다만 박 차관은 공격 주체에 대해선 “이란 내부의 상황에 대해서 구체적으로 주체를 확정하기는 매우 어렵다”고 했다. 이란 정규군이나 혁명수비대, 이란의 후견을 받는 후티 반군과 민병대 등을 특정하기는 어렵다는 것이다. 이에 대해 이날 발표에 동석한 류윤상(해군 준장) 국방부 국제차장은 미사일이 친이란 세력과 시리아 등에도 수출되기는 했다면서도 “기본적으로 호르무즈 해협 통제는 이란 혁명수비대와 해군이 하고 있지 않나 판단한다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Episode 6] In the Fog of Pyeongtaek ([6화] 평택의 안개 속에서)
item.description:
☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introductions (☞ 등장인물 소개)

As soon as Evan opened the door of Wings Burger in front of Camp Humphreys' main gate, the scent of cheddar cheese struck his nose. Six months into his stay in Korea, this worn-down burger joint was his only sanctuary left. It was the only place where he could taste the artery-clogging, salty, and greasy flavors of the homeland, which Korea's sleek artisan burger shops could never replicate. (에반이 캠프 험프리스 정문 앞 윙스버거의 가게 문을 열자마자 체다 치즈의 향이 코를 찔렀다. 한국에 온 지 6개월, 이 낡은 햄버거 가게가 에반에게 남은 유일한 안식처였다. 한국의 세련된 수제 버거집들이 도저히 흉내 낼 수 없는, 혈관이 막힐 듯 짜고 기름진 본토의 맛을 느낄 수 있는 유일한 곳이었다.)

At 8 PM, Evan bit into a double cheeseburger at a corner table. Around him, U.S. soldiers drank beer and chatted loudly, while Filipino JUSMAG women forced smiles beside them. The nights in Pyeongtaek were always like this. (저녁 8시, 에반은 구석 테이블에서 더블 치즈버거를 베어 물었다. 주변에서 미군 병사들이 맥주를 마시며 떠들고, 필리핀계 쥬씨들이 그들 옆에서 억지 미소를 지었다. 평택의 밤은 항상 이랬다.)

Emails from headquarters piled up on his smartphone screen. (스마트폰 화면에 본사 이메일이 쌓여 있다.)

The cursor blinked. 10 seconds. 20 seconds. Evan turned off the screen and flipped the phone over. He finished his burger in ten minutes and stepped outside. As he was about to pull out his car keys in the fog-laden parking lot, a familiar voice emerged from the darkness. (커서가 깜빡였다. 10초. 20초. 에반은 화면을 끄고 스마트폰을 엎었다. 햄버거를 10분만에 다 먹고 밖으로 나왔다. 안개가 내려앉은 주차장에서 차 키를 꺼내려는 순간, 어둠 속에서 익숙한 목소리가 들렸다.)

"Evan." (“에반.”)

Dressed in a suit, Jordan Hillman leaned against a black sedan and spoke to him. (정장 차림의 조던 힐먼이 검은색 세단에 기대어 선 채 말을 걸어왔다.)

"Get in the car." (“차에 타.”)

Without asking, Evan got into the passenger seat. (에반은 묻지 않고 조수석에 탔다.)

The air inside the car had already gone cold, suggesting Jordan had been standing there for quite a while. The engine was off too. If something needed to be delivered in a corner of a Pyeongtaek parking lot at this hour, it meant the conversation wasn't one to be had over the phone. (차 안 공기는 이미 식어 버린 상태였다. 조던이 여기 꽤 오래 서 있었다는 것을 짐작할 수 있었다. 엔진도 꺼져 있었다. 평택의 주차장 한구석에서, 이 시간에, 이런 방식으로 전달되어야 하는 이야기라면, 최소한 전화로 나눌 얘기는 아니라는 뜻이었다.)

The parking lot was nearly empty. A couple passed by in front of the car, close enough for Evan to hear the woman's laughter. Two silhouettes glided across the windshield and disappeared. Jordan waited until the footsteps faded completely. Then he reached under the seat, pulled out an encrypted tablet, and handed it to Evan. (주차장은 거의 비어 있었다. 한 커플이 차 앞을 지나쳤다. 여자의 웃음소리가 들릴 만큼 가까웠다. 두 실루엣이 앞유리 위로 스치고 사라졌다. 조던은 발자국 소리가 완전히 멀어질 때까지 기다렸다. 그리고 좌석 밑으로 손을 뻗어 암호화된 태블릿을 꺼내 에반에게 건넸다.)

"Look only. Don't say a word." (“눈으로만 봐. 아무 말도 하지 말고.”)

Jordan turned off the car's interior light. A streetlight about 30 meters away cast an orange glow into the fog. Evan tilted the tablet toward himself. The screen lit up. (조던이 차량 실내등을 껐다. 30미터쯤 떨어진 가로등 하나가 안개 속으로 주황색 빛을 흘렸다. 에반이 태블릿을 자기 쪽으로 기울였다. 화면이 켜졌다.)

It was a briefing document that Dudal had obtained and reprocessed from internal Korean government conversations intercepted by the NSA. Evan didn't change his expression. Being surprised here was an amateur move. (NSA가 감청한 한국 정부 내부의 대화를 듀다엘이 입수해 재가공한 브리핑 자료였다. 에반은 표정을 바꾸지 않았다. 여기서 놀라는 것은 아마추어의 반응이다.)

He scrolled down. From discussions on responding to U.S. troop reductions in Korea to the need for strengthening self-defense capabilities and lobbying activities by defense companies, various confidential conversations were included without filter. (스크롤을 내렸다. 주한미군 감축 대응 논의부터, 자주국방 강화 필요성, 방산 업체들의 로비 활동까지 각종 기밀 대화가 여과 없이 그대로 담겼다.)

Then, at one section, Evan's finger stopped. (그리곤 한 섹션에서 에반의 손가락이 멈췄다.)

"The U.S. military's withdrawal is actually an opportunity. There's no need to cling to foreign companies like Dudal. Please entrust this entire project to our Taesan's capabilities.
